title: ScienceOS Link v1 - shared definitions
description: Primitive aliases and small shared objects used by every other Link v1 schema. Conventions: Link-native fields are camelCase; fields inside mirrored backend payloads keep the backend's snake_case. Optional fields are omitted when unset (senders never emit null for them).

JsonValue.description: Any JSON value. Generators map this to the language's dynamic JSON type (TS unknown, Python Any, Swift JSONValue).

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with a literal Z suffix and 0-6 fractional digits, e.g. 2026-10-21T09:14:07.381204Z. Always UTC; never an offset.

Base64.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding. Used for binary payloads inside JSON.

Etag.description: Opaque validator. Compare for equality only; never parse.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as nextCursor.

OpId.description: Client-chosen idempotency key (UUID recommended). The host remembers the result of the last 256 opIds per device for 10 minutes and replays it instead of re-executing.

Scope.description: Capability granted to a paired device. read is implicit and always granted.

LinkVersion.description: major.minor. Within major 1 only additive changes occur.

StreamName.description: Name of an ordered, resumable event stream: host | run:{runId} | project:{projectId} | coedit:{docId}.

Seq.description: Per-stream event sequence number. Starts at 1, strictly increasing, never reused within an epoch.

AfterSeq.description: Resume cursor: the last seq the client has fully processed on a stream. 0 means from the start.

seq.description: Head seq at subscribe time (0 when the stream has no events yet).

replayed.description: Number of buffered events that will be delivered immediately after this response.

gap.description: True when afterSeq is older than the host's buffer (or the epoch changed). The client must refetch a snapshot instead of trusting incremental state.

ActionId.description: The tool call id of the pending approval/question (backend pending_actions.id).

DocId.description: Yjs document handle returned by coedit.open.

FilePath.description: Project-relative POSIX path. Never absolute, never contains a .. segment, a backslash or NUL; hosts reject violations with invalid_params.

Transport.description: How a session reached the host.

ActorRef.description: Who caused something. Used to attribute steering/approvals when desktop and phone act at once.
